title: AgentRank: State of the Agentic Web, No. 1 (dataset-v1)
description:
Behavioral agent-readiness measurements for 28 named websites: one fixed browser agent, a fixed-shape task, 280 trials across two Gemini models on 19 August 2026, scored against answers registered before any run. The static axis, Lighthouse's Agentic Browsing category, was re-measured on 23 September 2026 at Lighthouse 13.3.0, 13.4.1 and 13.5.0 and with the desktop preset, with every raw report retained.

The archive holds the data, the pre-registration record (docs/METHODOLOGY.md, append-only), the statistics computed in two languages and pinned by test vectors, and the code that produced them. The site at https://agent-score-weld.vercel.app documents it.

Data: CC BY 4.0, excluding third-party content captured inside raw reports and transcripts, such as the measured sites' own screenshots and page text (data/LICENSE.md). Code: MIT (LICENSE).
